parts.name: E22 LoRa Module (SX1262)
parts.description: SX1262 LoRa module on a 2x6 header breakout with an SMA antenna connector, pinout GND VCC / NRST NSS / SCK MOSI / MISO DIO1 / BUSY DIO2 / TXEN RXEN. Wire the ANT pins of two modules together and frames cross between them. Models command flow only, not range or modulation.
keywords: ebyte e22 e22-900m22s e22-400m22s long range transceiver 868 915 433 mhz
stm32 lora test board socket 2x6 header sma antenna radiolib
